name: Altar of Flesh
body:
School necromancy; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 2, death mage 2, inquisitor 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a dagger)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one corpse
Duration permanent, see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You carve symbols of your dark god into a corpse. From then on, it acts as a religious site or altar for other spells or abilities such as desecrate. If the corpse is destroyed, raised as an undead creature, or returned to life, the effect is lost.
